# stalwart_oauth_client (Data Source)

Defines a registered OAuth client application.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) Unique identifier of the OAuth client. It may be the HTTPS URL of a Client ID Metadata Document to pre-register an application that publishes one. Identifiers generated by this server never start with https://.
- `contacts` (Set of String) Contact email addresses for the OAuth client
- `created_at` (String) Creation date of the OAuth client
- `description` (String) Description of the OAuth client
- `expires_at` (String) Expiration date of the OAuth client
- `grant_types` (Set of String) OAuth grant types the client may use. The device authorization grant is only available when listed here.
- `logo` (String) URL or base64-encoded image representing the OAuth client
- `member_tenant_id` (String) Identifier for the tenant this OAuth client belongs to Requires an Enterprise license.
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (Set of String) URIs the client may ask to return to after signing out (OpenID Connect RP-Initiated Logout). A requested URI must match an entry exactly.
- `redirect_uris` (Set of String) List of redirect URIs for the OAuth client
- `scopes` (Set of String) Scopes the client may request. When empty, the client can only request sign-in (openid).
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret value of the OAuth client
